info.title: JustBuild
info.description: Analyzes .NET project dependencies and builds them in the correct order.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: JustBuild - analyzes implicit dependencies and builds .NET projects in the correct order.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --repository
options.description: Repository root path (auto-detected if not specified)

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration (default: Debug) [default: Debug]

options.name: --release
options.description: Set configuration to Release [default: False]

options.name: --debug
options.description: Set configuration to Debug [default: False]

options.name: --plan
options.description: Print the build plan to the console

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output and print build log

options.name: --build-log
options.description: Print build output to the console during build

options.name: --profile
options.description: Print build log filtered to steps taking >= 5% of total build time

options.name: --build
options.description: Force rebuild even if outputs are already up-to-date

options.name: --rebuild
options.description: Force rebuild with clean (sets --build and --clean)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Analyze and generate the build plan without building

options.name: --proj
options.description: Print the generated build project to the console

options.name: --clean
options.description: Add a Clean target before the build in the generated meta-project

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip Restore when building (do not add Restore target to the project)

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Enable parallel build execution (default: true)

options.name: --explicit
options.description: Set to false to skip explicitly referenced projects (default: true)

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: Use MSBuild as the builder when available (default: true)

options.name: --integration
options.description: Integration mode: disable console formatting for CI/CD (default: false)

options.name: --hash
options.description: Print the generated build project hash to the console

options.name: --proj-file
options.description: Save the generated build project to a file

arguments.name: PROJECT_PATH
arguments.description: Path to the project, solution or binary file (.csproj, .vbproj, .fsproj, .sln, .slnx, .dll, .exe)
